summary: Phase 2 (Admin Panel + 12 seeded bilingual products) full validation. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py — admin login, unauthorized guards (401), /api/admin/stats returns {products:{total:12,published:12,drafts:0}, categories:10, brands>=15, models>=12}, full CRUD for categories/brands/models/products/reviews/guides with bilingual (EN/HI) payloads, product publish-toggle correctly flips /api/products visibility, public /api/products returns exactly 12 items each with content.en.shortReview & content.hi.shortReview >100 chars, /api/products?category=mobiles returns the expected 4 slugs {google-pixel-10, oneplus-15, iqoo-15r, realme-narzo-90x-5g}, all 12 slugs reachable at /api/products/:slug with full bilingual content, reviews & guides public endpoints filter published only. Frontend: /admin/login -> /admin redirect works with admin@dealpicker.in / dealpicker2025, dashboard shows '12', /admin/products lists 12 rows, /admin/{categories,brands,models,reviews,guides,products/new} all load with expected testids, public Site header/footer hidden on /admin routes, Sign out clears session and redirects to /admin/login, unauth /admin also redirects to /admin/login. Public site: /category/mobiles shows exactly the 4 expected mobile products, /category/earbuds shows exactly the 3 expected earbud products, product detail /product/iqoo-15r renders Devanagari specs + description + 'Amazon पर खरीदें' + affiliate link (https://link.amazon/...) when locale=hi, EN->HI switch on /product/oneplus-15 injects Devanagari content into the Review tab, newsletter form present with data-testid, custom 404 correctly returns HTTP 404.

issues: Main product image area shows 'No image' placeholder. Expected per agent note — user will upload images later via admin panel. Not flagged as a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin route guard is correctly wired: any path starting with 'admin/' calls requireAdmin() and returns 401 if no valid Bearer token (verified with POST /api/admin/products and GET /api/admin/stats).
Product publish toggle route (POST /api/admin/products/:id/publish) correctly mutates published flag and public /api/products filters {published:true} — verified by round-trip test.

Bilingual normalizeProduct correctly preserves both content.en.* and content.hi.* on create/update; specs are stored as [{key,value}] arrays and rendered in Devanagari on the product detail page when locale=hi.

Homepage renders 11/12 products because one seeded product (lenovo-v15-g4-ryzen-5-7520u) is not tagged as todaysDeal/trending/featured, so it doesn't appear in any homepage section. This matches the review request wording ('12 products or filtered by todaysDeal/trending/featured across sections') — not a bug but worth noting for the main agent if all 12 should appear on the homepage.
Minor Next.js warning: 'Detected scroll-behavior: smooth on <html>' — cosmetic, no functional impact.
route.js is 572 lines — single monster handler. Would benefit from being split into /app/app/api/admin/*/route.js and /app/app/api/(public)/*/route.js for maintainability, but functionally correct.
